question: How did each salesperson's annual total sales compare to their annual sales quota? Provide the difference between their total sales and the quota for each year, organized by salesperson and year.
sql:
WITH annual_sales AS (
  SELECT TRY_CAST(salespersonid AS INTEGER) as businessentityid,
         CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(orderdate AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) as year,
         SUM(TRY_CAST(totaldue AS DOUBLE)) as total_sales
  FROM salesorderheader
  WHERE salespersonid IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CAST(salespersonid AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY salespersonid, CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(orderdate AS DATE)) AS INTEGER)
),
annual_quota AS (
  SELECT TRY_CAST(BusinessEntityID AS INTEGER) as businessentityid,
         CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(QuotaDate AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER) as year,
         SUM(TRY_CAST(SalesQuota AS DOUBLE)) as total_quota
  FROM SalesPersonQuotaHistory
  GROUP BY BusinessEntityID, CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(QuotaDate AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER)
),
all_combos AS (
  SELECT s.businessentityid, s.year
  FROM annual_sales s
  UNION
  SELECT q.businessentityid, q.year
  FROM annual_quota q
)
SELECT ac.businessentityid,
       ac.year,
       COALESCE(ROUND(a.total_sales, 2), 0) as total_sales,
       COALESCE(ROUND(q.total_quota, 2), 0) as total_quota,
       ROUND(COALESCE(a.total_sales, 0) - COALESCE(q.total_quota, 0), 2) as difference
FROM all_combos ac
LEFT JOIN annual_sales a ON ac.businessentityid = a.businessentityid AND ac.year = a.year
LEFT JOIN annual_quota q ON ac.businessentityid = q.businessentityid AND ac.year = q.year
ORDER BY ac.businessentityid, ac.year
